g.text: The 2007 figures show only the 8088 side of the 8284 (Fig 1: "8284 Pin 8, 5, 10").

g.desc: The 2007 figures show only the 8088 side of the 8284 (Fig 1: "8284 Pin 8, 5, 10").

g.text: This sheet is rebuilt from the 8284A datasheet and skeet.asm:

g.desc: This sheet is rebuilt from the 8284A datasheet and skeet.asm:

g.text: 12 MHz crystal, F/~{C} low: CLK = 4 MHz (8088), PCLK = 2 MHz (8253 clocks).

g.desc: 12 MHz crystal, F/~{C} low: CLK = 4 MHz (8088), PCLK = 2 MHz (8253 clocks).

g.text: Always ready: RDY1 high + ~{AEN1} low; RDY2 low + ~{AEN2} high. ~{ASYNC} low.

g.desc: Always ready: RDY1 high + ~{AEN1} low; RDY2 low + ~{AEN2} high. ~{ASYNC} low.

g.text: ~{RES}: 10k / 10uF power-on reset (about 100 ms) plus a reset button.

g.desc: ~{RES}: 10k / 10uF power-on reset (about 100 ms) plus a reset button.

g.text: Power pins (VCC 18, GND 9) not drawn, as on the 2007 figures.

g.desc: Power pins (VCC 18, GND 9) not drawn, as on the 2007 figures.
